title: What Rainmaking Programs 2.0 Is
definition: Rainmaking Programs 2.0: next-gen responsible rain enhancement.
description:

title: Real Research Today: Rainmaking Programs 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Rainmaking Programs 2.0.
description:
The road to Rainmaking Programs 2.0 is already being paved. The Great Green Wall initiative restores 100M hectares across Africa's Sahel. Direct air capture plants (Climeworks Orca/Mammoth) operate in Iceland.

Solar geoengineering research (Harvard SCoPEx heritage, Degrees Initiative) studies governance first. Together these programs form the cloud seeding foundation that Rainmaking Programs 2.0 will build on — the program logistics results, the water rights methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as program logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Rainmaking Programs 2.0
definition: Estimates Rainmaking Programs 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Rainmaking Programs 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a program hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Rainmaking Programs 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Rainmaking Programs 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 38180 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where cloud seeding monitoring, program logistics redundancy, or water rights maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Rainmaking Programs 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Rainmaking Programs 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Rainmaking Programs 2.0 — next-gen responsible rain enhancement.

Phase 1 — Prove (cloud seeding): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (water rights): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (efficacy proof): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and arid regions-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
